about: SHADER layers (r180, docs/effect-layers.md phase 3): conformance pages with a layer drawn through WAVE and a white mist band (core/test-data/shaders/mist.png, in HiverFog.atlas) drawn through FOG, in every repeat mode, and a cross-fade into the page on screen while tinting. The effects move on the reader's clock, so t6 and t12 catch them at different phases. Written by core/test-data/shaders/make_round.py. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: wave-fog-repeat-X
scenes.about: c01 (repeat X, trimmed regions): the near hills (a trimmed region) ripple, a mist band drifts through FOG between the two front layers

scenes.name: wave-fog-repeat-XY
scenes.about: c02 (repeat X and Y, padded), scrolling up at 30 units/s too: a ripple running down, a padded mist tiled both ways

scenes.name: wave-fog-repeat-Y-mirror
scenes.about: c03 (repeat Y, mirrored copies to the right), scrolling up at 30 units/s too: a mirrored layer ripples with its copy, a flipped mirrored hill thins through FOG

scenes.name: wave-fog-no-repeat
scenes.about: c05 (no repeat): a flipped layer ripples wide, clamped to its region; a WAVE with no wavelength draws plain; a FOG amplitude of 1.7 thins at most fully

scenes.name: shaders-cross-fade-tinted
scenes.about: s01 cross-fading into itself (its layers cloned) while tinting orange: both pages shade on one clock, faded and tinted

scenes.name: fog-across-the-tiles
scenes.about: r229: the mist alone, 20 of 40 units wide, its noise period (40) twice the image, tiling on X over near-black gradients: the noise runs on across every tile edge, also after the layer wraps (t6, t12), instead of starting again at each
